description: Source code for a BitBucket API client class that facilitates fetching files, listing directory contents, and managing repository information from BitBucket repositories.

classes.name: BitBucketClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with BitBucket API to fetch files, list directory contents, and retrieve repository info.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BitBucketClient with configuration parameters, setting up authentication headers and HTTP handler.

methods.name: get_file_content
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specified file from the repository, decoding base64 if necessary.

methods.name: list_files
methods.description: Lists files in a directory with a specific extension, defaulting to '.prompt'.

methods.name: test_connection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the repository by attempting to retrieve repository info.

methods.name: get_branches
methods.description: Retrieves a list of branches in the repository.

methods.name: get_file_metadata
methods.description: Gets metadata about a specific file, such as size and last modified date.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HTTP handler to free resources.
